svg.aria-label: VLANs. 10 Management: 192.168.10.0/24, gateway .254, static, for switches, the Proxmox host and the admin workstation. 20 Internal: 192.168.20.0/24, gateway .254, DHCP from SWAGGER-DC-01 relayed by the core, for trusted users, Internal Wi-Fi and WKS-01. 30 Guest: 192.168.30.0/24, gateway .254, DHCP pool on the core switch, visitor Wi-Fi with internet only. 40 Servers: 192.168.40.0/24, gateway .254, static, for virtual machines and the UNAS Pro. Native VLAN 999 carries no hosts.
